apiVersion.description: Serialized schema version. `v1` is the stable milestone manifest-spec.md:2325-2338 reserves for the end of the lifecycle v1alpha1 -> v1beta1 -> v1, so the alpha value is the honest one until the V1.0 gate is met (ADR 0014). An unrecognized value fails with UNSUPPORTED_API_VERSION rather than being parsed best-effort.

publisherId.description: Lowercase kebab-case, globally unique within the Catalog (catalog-spec.md:286-308).

packageId.description: Lowercase kebab-case, unique within its Publisher (catalog-spec.md:310-338).

capabilityId.description: Dot-separated semantic namespace, publisher- and target-independent (catalog-spec.md:340-361).

componentName.description: Upstream logical component name, not a filesystem path (catalog-spec.md:2015-2031).
